name: Bill & Ted's Excellent Adventure: Arcade
summary:
Join Bill S. Preston Esq. and Ted Theodore Logan in this most excellent action-adventure 16-bit arcade game! Bag and challenge famous figures from history in preparation for your report, oh and save the world while you’re at it!

Play as Bill or Ted, or team up for some couch cooperative multiplayer in this 15-level side-scrolling arcade action game. You’ll get the chance to meet all of the characters from the original movie as you battle through time to save the future. Find Billy the Kid, Socrates, Napoleon, Beethoven and Ghengis Khan and go head-to-head with them in unique mini-games in order to win them over to help you on your quest.
